name: Box ssh probe (does the hub reach each box over ssh)

knobs.note: BH-7710: seconds each `ssh root@<ip> true` probe may take before timeout kills it (rc 124). Every box is probed at once, so a tick lasts about this long. Read by bin/box-ssh-probe.sh as ${BOX_SSH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-15}; a value that is not a positive integer is one ALERTS line and no probe.

BH-7710: the window bin/box-ssh-probe.sh counts state/pool-tailnet/<ip>.fails lines in (lane_fails), read as ${POOL_TAILNET_WINDOW_S:-900}. The same name and default as the fly-pool knob that bin/lib/pool-tailnet.sh ptn_note uses (BH-6693); set both rows to the same value. A value that is not a positive integer is 900.
Read by bin/box-ssh-probe.sh as ${BOX_SSH_PROBE_SSH:-ssh ...}: the ssh command each probe runs before root@<ip> true. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
Read by bin/box-ssh-probe.sh as ${BOX_SSH_PROBE_NOW:-<date +%s>}: the clock the pool-tailnet window is counted from. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
